CLIENTSSL_PASSTHROUGH
Description
Triggered when the SSL receive the plaintext data and enter the
passthrough mode.
Examples
when
CLIENTSSL_PASSTHROUGH
{
SSL
::
collect
}
when
CLIENTSSL_DATA
{
log
local0.
"[IP::client_addr]:[TCP::client_port]: Collected bytes [SSL::payload length]"
log
local0.
"[IP::client_addr]:[TCP::client_port]: Decrypted payload (\[SSL::payload\]): [SSL::payload]"
log
local0.
"[IP::client_addr]:[TCP::client_port]: Parsed first line: [SSL::payload 0 [string first \r\n [SSL::payload]]]"
SSL
::
release
}
